description: This vertical bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," illustrates accuracy metrics across two distinct evaluation categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy" and utilizes a linear scale with a displayed range from 0.0 to 0.6, featuring numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The data is presented using grouped bars, where a set of three bars is arranged side-by-side for each horizontal category. A legend below the chart identifies the components of these groups: red bars represent "Base," light green bars represent "RMU with Enhanced GCG," and yellow bars represent "RMU." Within each group, the bars are sorted in descending order of height from left to right. Visually, all bars are outlined in black, and each is emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it. For the "MCQ Eval" category, the "Base" bar is the tallest in the chart at 0.644, followed by "RMU with Enhanced GCG" at 0.539, and "RMU" at 0.299. In the "Generation Eval" category, the "Base" bar reaches 0.597, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" bar is 0.263, and the "RMU" bar is the shortest in the chart at 0.106.
